messages:
Nate O'Connor: Quick feedback from today's design review on the model catalog compare view — a few accessibility & copy nits around filters, badges, and pinning. TL;DR: make filter reset clearer, avoid disappearing pins, and clarify perf badge language :memo:
Lina Park: thanks Nate. saw the prototype. the filter chips collapse into an overflow menu on small widths and the "clear all" becomes a tiny icon-only button. users in test missed it.
Rohan Iyer: can you repro steps? I didn't catch that in my run
Nate O'Connor: Catalog > Filters > add 3 filters > shrink window width. The chips collapse and the clear action turns into just an X icon with no label. users expected a text button.
Daniella Cruz: UX suggestion: always show "Clear filters" text at <md> breakpoints, or at least add an accessible label on the icon with aria-label="Clear all filters". Also add a confirm toast "Filters cleared" for discoverability
ux-helper-bot: Accessibility check: Icon-only actions must have aria-labels. For discoverability, consider visible text at md and larger. Ensure the clear action is focusable and part of logical tab order after the filter chips.
Lina Park: copy tweak: change toast from "Cleared" to "Filters cleared" and include count like "Filters cleared (3)" so users know what happened.
Rohan Iyer: noted. Next: performance badges — users confused by "Perf: 0.87" metric. They asked what the scale is and whether higher is better. Copy should indicate direction and units.
Daniella Cruz: propose: badge text: "Perf 87 — lower latency · lower cost = better" (or better: split into two values and show small summary: "Perf 87 (latency 120ms, est $0.002/tk)")
Nate O'Connor: prefer the latter. show primary score plus 2-line microcopy on hover. For the compact compare table, we can't show 2 lines inline so hover card must be robust. Keep badge accessible via keyboard (enter/space opens card).
ux-helper-bot: Tooltip guidance: use role="tooltip" for simple read-only content and aria-describedby on the badge for SR. If the hover card contains interactive controls (e.g., view details, pin version), use role="dialog" and manage focus.
Lina Park: about pinning: when a user pins a version the row gets a pin icon in the badges column. In compact/dense mode that column collapses and pins vanish from view which confuses users during tests.
Rohan Iyer: implementation idea: persist a subtle left-edge stripe on pinned rows (2px) and reveal full pin icon on hover/focus. Also ensure the pin control has aria-pressed and a tooltip that reads "Pinned to version vX.Y.Z"
Daniella Cruz: stripe idea is good but check contrast. Alternative: tiny persistent dot at row start with accessible label. Either way, screen reader needs immediate context: add aria-roledescription="pinned row" for pinned rows or include a visually-hidden label.
ux-helper-bot: Contrast note: 2px stripe may fail at small widths. If color contrast <3:1, increase to 3px or add an outline. Also ensure stripe is not solely color dependent; add shape or icon fallback for colorblind accessibility.
Nate O'Connor: keyboard flow: tab order currently hits row actions before the badge. For SR users we should surface pin state earlier. propose tab order: checkbox -> pin -> badge -> actions.
Lina Park: agreed. Also update storybook stories to include a keyboard-interaction snapshot and add an axe-core run for the compare component.
Rohan Iyer: small dev note: the chevrons live in a portal which caused z-index issues with badge tooltips in a previous bug. We'll ensure global tooltip layer z-index is above action portal and add a 100ms show delay for tooltips to reduce flicker.
Daniella Cruz: microcopy tasks: update tooltip copy file strings to: "Perf (latency · est cost): {score}" and the pin tooltip to "Pinned to version {version}". Also add toast text changes.
ux-helper-bot: Checklist for PR: 1) aria-labels on icon-only controls, 2) aria-pressed on pin, 3) aria-describedby for perf badge, 4) keyboard tab-order test, 5) contrast check for stripe/dot, 6) tooltip z-index + delay, 7) storybook accessibility snapshots.
Nate O'Connor: action items: Rohan -> PR with z-index + tooltip delay + tab-order change; Lina -> update Figma to show stripe/dot variants and copy; Daniella -> update microcopy tokens and toasts; Nate -> add test plan and usability notes. I'll ping eng-frontend once PR is ready for review. Thanks all :)
